items.heading: IT Treats Campus Placement As
items.text: It treats campus placement as the "real" placement and off-campus as a consolation prize, which does not match how much fresher hiring actually happens off-campus today.

items.heading: IT Treats Off
items.text: It treats off-campus as something you start only after campus placements disappoint you, losing the strongest early hiring windows of the year.

items.heading: IT Skips Real Tier
items.text: It skips real tier-wise placement data, leaving students to guess whether their college's numbers are actually normal or a genuine red flag.

items.heading: IT Rarely Explains Referrals Properly,
items.text: It rarely explains referrals properly, even though referrals fill a large share of off-campus roles before the listing is public.
